cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is Cocamidopropyl Betaine @2 (amphoteric), followed by mild anionics Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate @3, Disodium Laureth Sulfosuccinate @4, Sodium Lauryl Sulfoacetate @5. Counter-signal: three mild anionics give a reasonably effective sulfate-free system; PPG-2 Hydroxyethyl Cocamide @19 is a foam booster, not a route.

conditioningLevel.rationale: high by C2: early (prominent) silicone Amodimethicone/Morpholinomethyl Silsesquioxane Copolymer @18, cationic polymer Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @16, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @6, humectant Glycerin @17; further routes Helianthus Annuus Seed Oil @15, Quaternium-95 @26. Counter-signal: silicone, guar and oil all sit after Piroctone Olamine @12 (capped active), so each is likely low-level; neighbor moderate.

weightPotential.rationale: high: converging, plausibly persistent deposition families (amino-silicone copolymer @18, cationic guar @16, cationic conditioner Quaternium-95 @26, material payload lipid Sunflower Seed Oil @15) face a weak reset (C6 low chassis); W-RICH (material oil + silicone/cationic) with limited reset meets the high anchor, and the convergence route holds independently of the lipid. Confidence moderate: every deposition entry is listed after Piroctone Olamine @12, so the load may be lighter; neighbor moderate.
